INCIDENT_META.register: Demo Change and Incident Register v1.0: one workbook holding a Change Register, an Incident Register and lookup lists
INCIDENT_META.process: Incident Management Process v1.0; reporting form in the service desk tool
INCIDENT_META.categories: Cat 1 Critical · Cat 2 High · Cat 3 Medium · Cat 4 Low
INCIDENT_META.reporting: Regulatory reportability (e.g. GDPR, and NIS2 where applicable) is recorded per incident, with the 24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification and one-month final report tracked separately.
INCIDENT_META.dataNote: The incident rows below are fictional demo records.
INCIDENT_META.openGap: Demo corrective action NC-DEMO-04: the incident process lacks a documented escalation procedure.

INCIDENTS.title: Office power cut for 3 h, staff moved to remote working, no customer impact
INCIDENTS.detail: Mains power to the office dropped at 09:45. Staff switched to remote working on laptops; all production services run with the cloud provider and were unaffected.
INCIDENTS.rootCause: Fault in the building landlord's electrical supply.
INCIDENTS.corrective: Agree an outage notification SLA with the landlord; add a remote-working switchover to the business continuity test.

INCIDENTS.title: Retired laptops stored in an unlocked cupboard awaiting e-waste collection
INCIDENTS.detail: Found on a routine walk-round. Devices were wiped but not yet collected; they were moved to locked storage and collected by a certified e-waste contractor.
INCIDENTS.rootCause: No defined holding area or collection schedule for retired equipment.
INCIDENTS.corrective: Define a locked e-waste holding area; schedule quarterly collections; update the asset disposal procedure.

INCIDENTS.title: DDoS against the SaaS web front end, degraded latency only
INCIDENTS.detail: HTTP flood over about two hours. The cloud provider's DDoS protection engaged automatically; some customers saw brief latency increases.
INCIDENTS.rootCause: External botnet; rate-limiting rules on the web application firewall were too permissive.
INCIDENTS.corrective: Tighten WAF rate limits; run an annual DDoS tabletop with the cloud provider; update the customer status-page playbook.

CHANGES.what: Physical security standard: define minimum access log retention (6 months)
Privacy notice: set access log retention to a maximum of 2 years
CHANGES.why: Customer assurance reports need a full year of logs

CHANGES.what: AI policy: add a meeting transcription tool to the approved list
Incident procedure: notify the certification body of major incidents
Firewall rule review cadence changed to quarterly

INC_PRIORITY.desc: Critical incident with serious economic impact and/or affecting a significant part of, or all, users and customers.
Serious fault affecting a minor part of users and customers, or a separate area.
Impact on individual customers and users; not critical for the business.
Small or no impact; a workaround is in place.

INC_PERSPECTIVES.critical: Extensive impact at the main site or multiple locations
INC_PERSPECTIVES.high: Impact at a single site, more than 50% of the site
INC_PERSPECTIVES.medium: Less than 50% of a single site, or a single department
INC_PERSPECTIVES.low: Less than a single department, or a single customer

INC_PERSPECTIVES.high: Significant impact on a single customer
INC_PERSPECTIVES.medium: Limited effect on a single customer

INC_PERSPECTIVES.high: A system unavailable with business impact; no redundancy
